messages:
anika: Quick thread to lock down a 'headroom policy' -- mapping commit tiers to allowed burst behavior + contract flags for fallback routing. want an opinionated default so sales/ops have a single source of truth.
ben: +1. too many custom asks lately; we need a matrix: tier -> % headroom -> routing priority -> overage behavior.
lena: sales: agree. customers want a clear tradeoff table. proposing columns: headroom %, uplift, priority lane (gold/silver/bronze), overage billing, auto-throttle threshold.
marco: engineering POV: priority lane implies routing + capacity allocation. we can map priority to guaranteed QPS share on Dedicated and best-effort on Hosted. extra work for priority lanes: ~3 infra sprints.
clare: cs: include a 'contract flag' meta (e.g., "ALLOW_RETRO_SMOOTHING", "PRIORITY_ROUTING") so we can programmatically enforce entitlements and show in console. keeps account state machine clean.
ben: sample row: Tier=Pro, Headroom=25%, Uplift=+10%, Priority=silver, Overage=auto-bill @1.5x, Throttle=2.5x. Thoughts?
anika: looks good. Legal: clawback rules must be explicit. if retro smoothing allowed, define abuse as >50% exceedance in 2/6 months -> triggers renegotiation.
legal-bot: Suggested clause: "Customer smoothing usage is intended for short spikes. Repeated sustained exceedance (defined as smoothing-exceeded in more than 2 of any trailing 6 calendar months by >50%) entitles Redwood to require commit uplift or bill for overages retroactively."

lena: sales question: can we offer a programmatic 'safety valve' so customers can temporarily upgrade priority for 7d during predictable spikes? useful for renewals.
marco: technically feasible: a short-lived priority token that pushes into a higher lane; implement as a token ledger + ephemeral routing rule. cost: 1 sprint infra + 1 sprint controller. must gate by capacity.
clare: UX: console should show current headroom remaining, next-threshold warnings, and a one-click 'request temporary upgrade' that routes to sales flow.
ben: launch criteria (MVP) proposal: 1) policy matrix published, 2) contract flags implemented, 3) console badge + warnings, 4) billing behavior for overages clear, 5) sales playbook + sample SOW language.
anika: KPIs to track: % accounts hitting headroom, avg overage $, number of temporary upgrades, incidents from priority routing, revenue impact.
marco: ops safety: enforce a hard-enforce throttle at 4x daily baseline regardless of headroom to protect cluster health. add automated alerts for capacity planners when aggregate headroom consumption > 70% of reserve.
lena: migration: customers on ad-hoc burst credits get mapped to 'Bronze token' default with a pro-rated conversion option and 90d sunset notice for old credits. include migration calculator.
ben: pricing ask: create standard uplift bands: +8% for 15% headroom, +18% for 35% headroom, +35% for 75% headroom. finance to validate but need to present numbers in deck.
clare: backlogs to create: PRIC-HEAD-001 policy matrix & doc, PRIC-HEAD-002 contract flags + legal text, PRIC-HEAD-003 console UI + upgrade flow, PRIC-HEAD-004 routing tokens + throttles.
anika: pilot plan: small pilot (5 accounts) on Pro band, allow 1 temp upgrade per customer. ben/lena to nominate pilots by Wed. marco to confirm infra ETA. I'll draft policy matrix + legal stub by EOW. @pricing-bot create epic PRIC-HEADROOM. :white_check_mark:
pricing-bot: Epic PRIC-HEADROOM created (https://go/repo/PRIC-HEADROOM) - owners: anika, marco, ben.
